source: https://arxiv.org/html/2106.09685v2 (Sections 1, 4.1-4.2, 5.5, 7.1-7.2, 8, Appendix F.3, H.2; Tables 4, 5, 16, 18) incl. Figure 1 image used by the post
sampling: 27 body blocks numbered from L16; started at block 3 and took every second block, then wrapped (L22→front matter L7, L16, L38, L46 x2, L48, L58, L69 x2, L73, L80, L34, L42, L88, L90), 15 claims, 9 of them numbers. The whole post was read for wrong claims outside the sample.

A: L56 is a sentence about the post ('전체 미세조정 기준선과 이 방법들을 한 표에 정리했습니다'). Markup is otherwise clean (front matter complete, $$ math, H2/H3 only).
B: L34 '... 결국 갱신 크기를 조절하는 학습률과 비슷한 역할을 합니다' → '... 학습률처럼 갱신 크기를 조절합니다'.
L22 '더 큰 문제는 ... 경우가 많다는 데 있습니다' → '더구나 ... 경우가 많았습니다'.
L54 '앞서 소개한 전체 파라미터를 모두 학습하는 전체 미세조정' is redundant → '전체 미세조정'.
C: L69 'W_q와 W_v를 함께 적응하는 쪽이 WikiSQL에서 더 높았습니다' restates L46 inside the Table 4 discussion and interrupts it.
L54's thesis says '비슷하거나 더 높은 점수', but the TL;DR (L16) only reports near-equality, so the two framings of the same result don't line up.
D: Baselines (L56) and benchmarks (L58) are not glossed. L84 subspace similarity is not explained. Easy steps (L38 count, L80 chance level) are well calibrated.
E: Tables are verbatim and well placed. A small Table 5 extract (W_q 70.4 / W_q,W_v 73.7 / all four 73.7 at the same 18M) would have shown the allocation choice more clearly than the prose at L46, and the prose leaves out that adapting all four at r=2 ties W_q+W_v on WikiSQL.
F: L34 adds an unsupported mechanism ('ΔWx 전체의 크기를 바꾸므로 ... 학습률과 비슷한 역할') without marking it as the writer's. Numbers in both tables and prose are correct. L16's '약 25% 빨랐습니다' right after 32.5→43.1 (+33% throughput) is the paper's own speedup figure, so it is not an error, but the pairing is confusing.

U1: Five-question arc is covered (L18-92). Missing: the memory/storage savings (Sec 4.2: 1.2TB → 350GB VRAM, 350GB → 35MB checkpoint) and any non-GPT-3 experiment (RoBERTa, DeBERTa, GPT-2), so 'why it matters' rests on latency and task switching only.
U2: L16 TL;DR is five sentences, longer than two to three lines, and headlines the 18M ablation (Table 5) rather than the main table.

claim_headings.evidence: Fixed summary headings are topic names (L18 '## 연구 배경', L26 '## 제안 방법', L44 '## 구현 방식', L52 '## 실험 결과', L82 '## 의의와 한계'), but each section opens with a one-line thesis (L20, L28, L46, L54).

running_example.evidence: GPT-3 175B and WikiSQL thread through TL;DR (L16), rank allocation (L46) and main table (L58-69); the only worked numeric example is a hypothetical 12,288-dim matrix (L38) that is not tied back to the 18M budget.

mechanism_choice_formula_example.evidence: Problem (L22) → design choice vs adapters/prefix (L40-42) → formula h=W0x+BAx (L32) → numeric example 98,304 vs ~1억 5,100만 (L38).

facts_once.evidence: 18M/73.7 appears in description (L8), TL;DR (L16) and L46; 32.5/43.1/25% in L16 and L50; the W_q vs W_q+W_v finding is restated at L69 ('앞서 구현 방식에서 본 대로 ... W_q와 W_v를 함께 적응하는 쪽이 WikiSQL에서 더 높았습니다'); latency/sequence-length limits of adapters/prefix at L16, L22, L40.

numbers_with_scope.evidence: Most numbers carry model, metric and setting (L46 '96개 층', L69 '4.7M 파라미터를 쓴 LoRA'); but M counts are not converted in prose (L16 '파라미터 175,255.8M개', L69 '4.7M', '37.7M'), and L16 pairs a throughput rise 32.5→43.1 (+33%) with '약 25% 빨랐습니다' without saying 25% is the paper's speedup figure.

nothing_invented.evidence: No invented numbers or tables; Table 4 and Table 16 match cell for cell. One unlabelled causal explanation at L34 ('α/r은 ΔWx 전체의 크기를 바꾸므로, 결국 ... 학습률과 비슷한 역할을 합니다') goes beyond the paper; L38 example is labelled '가상의 예'.

writer_assessment_end.evidence: L92 '이 글의 판단으로는 ...' gives a deployment decision (merge vs not, check r and target matrices for far domains), though it leans on the paper's own batching limitation.

length_fit.evidence: About 6,100 body characters, five sections, two tables; fits a short method paper summary.

type_shape.evidence: Five fixed summary sections and one distilled main-results table (L58-67), but the TL;DR (L16) is a five-sentence paragraph rather than two to three lines.

korean_style.evidence: Consistent 입니다 register; residual patterns: '결국' (L22, L34), '역할을 합니다' (L34), noun frame '못 미치는 경우가 많다는 데 있습니다' (L22), meta sentence '한 표에 정리했습니다' (L56), redundant '앞서 소개한 전체 파라미터를 모두 학습하는 전체 미세조정' (L54).

top_issues: L8/L16: the TL;DR/description headline is the 18M ablation (Table 5, 73.7 vs 73.8), not Table 4's 4.7M/37.7M rows. The TL;DR runs to five sentences, leaves out LoRA's MNLI-m/SAMSum wins over FT, and pairs 32.5→43.1 tokens/s with '약 25%'.

Coverage (U1): the post reports only GPT-3 175B. RoBERTa/DeBERTa on GLUE and GPT-2 on E2E are never mentioned, and neither is the memory/storage saving the paper calls 'the most significant benefit' (Sec 4.2: training VRAM 1.2TB → 350GB, checkpoint 350GB → 35MB at r=4 on W_q,W_v). Nothing in L44-50 or L84 covers it.
L34: an unsupported α/r mechanism. L56: a meta sentence, and the baselines go undefined. L69: repeats the L46 W_q+W_v finding (both were left after the run's own review).
